meta.title: Recoil trainer for Apex Legends
meta.description: Practice the spray pattern of every Apex Legends weapon in your browser, with each magazine and fire mode. See where every round lands and track your progress.

search.title: Search weapons
search.description: Type a name, then press Enter to pick the weapon.

range.label: Practice range
range.instruction: Click and hold anywhere in the range to spray
range.instructionBurst: Click and hold anywhere in the range to fire bursts
range.instructionSingle: Click anywhere in the range to fire, once for each shot
range.hintPath: Follow the path with your aim as the gun climbs, and your shots stay on the start point.
range.hint: Pull against the climb to keep your shots on the start point.
range.hintMoving: Pull against the climb and keep your shots on the moving target.
range.tooSmall: The range is too small for this pattern. Raise the sensitivity or make the window larger.

result.title: Run complete
result.notSaved: Not saved: only a full magazine at full speed counts.

session.title: Session
session.firstRun: Your first run today shows up here.
session.trendEmpty: Your runs from today appear here as a trend.
session.trendLabel: Scores of today’s runs, from {{first}} to {{last}}, best {{best}}

tips.title: Before you start
tips.pointer: Turn off “Enhance pointer precision” in Windows mouse settings. <guide>How</guide>
tips.sensitivity: Enter your in-game sensitivity so patterns match the game. <settings>Set it</settings>

settingsDialog.title: Settings
settingsDialog.description: Changes apply at once and stay in this browser.
settingsDialog.sensitivityHint: Your mouse sensitivity in the game.
settingsDialog.adsHint: Your aiming multiplier from the game; runs use sensitivity × ADS. Keep 1.0 if your sensitivity already includes it.
settingsDialog.recoilHint: Moving the target is closer to how the game feels.
settingsDialog.firingSpeedHint: Slow the spray down while you learn a pattern. Only runs at full speed are saved.
settingsDialog.scaleHint: Stretches what the range draws; scores stay the same.

help.title: How to practice
help.description: Set up once, then spray, read the result and go again.
help.pointer: Turn off “Enhance pointer precision” in your mouse settings.
help.sensitivity: Enter your sensitivity and ADS multiplier in Settings.
help.pick: Pick a weapon and a magazine.
help.spray: Press in the range and pull against the recoil until the magazine is empty.
help.score: The closer your shots stay on the target, the higher the score, up to 100.

consent.label: Analytics cookies
consent.text: We use Google Analytics cookies to see how the trainer is used. Nothing is tracked unless you accept.

phone.title: Recoil patterns for every weapon
phone.intro: Practicing needs a mouse and a larger screen. Here you can study each pattern before you train.

patterns.title: Recoil patterns
patterns.description: The recoil pattern of every Apex Legends weapon, for each magazine and fire mode. Watch each spray shot by shot, then practice it in your browser.
patterns.intro: Each weapon's spray, drawn as the path your aim follows to keep the shots on the start point. Pick a weapon to study it, then practice with it.
patterns.read: Start on the ring and follow the line with your aim as the gun climbs: your shots stay on the ring.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Your Apex Legends recoil practice over time: best and median scores by day and by weapon. Runs are stored in this browser only.
progress.stored: Stored in this browser only. Clearing site data removes it.
progress.chartLabel: Best and median score per day: best {{best}}, median {{median}}, over {{days}} days of practice
progress.recentEmpty: Runs you save in the trainer from now on are listed here with their times.
progress.noDays: No saved runs in this period.
progress.emptyText: A run is saved when you empty a full magazine at full speed. Your days, weapons and runs then show up here.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: There is nothing at this address. The link may be wrong, or the page may have moved.

serverError.title: Something went wrong
serverError.text: The server couldn't complete this request. Try again in a moment, or go back to the trainer.
